responsibility: This implementation module provides the SHORTREAL elementary math wrappers for GNU Modula-2 by binding selected procedures such as sqrt, sin, and cos to GCC-recognized builtin forms through cbuiltin while routing the remaining operations through libm single-precision functions like expf, logf, tanf, atanf, and floorf. It is the single-precision companion to MathLib0 and LMathLib0, supplying the runtime implementation behind the SMathLib0 SHORTREAL interface.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the SMathLib0 pair: it defines the SHORTREAL routines by mapping the interface from SMathLib0.def onto cbuiltin single-precision builtins and libm *f functions such as expf, logf, tanf, atanf, and floorf.
